draws: impact.resolve on a cloned stream, then one uniform_index(candidate_count) when landed (0 draws for 0 candidates per uniform_index contract)
order: impact resolution first, then ordinal; candidate order = aura_projections canonical order
quote: quote operates on context.state.random.clone(); receipt recorded, stream not advanced
failure: quote failure after the clone leaves the real stream untouched
reset: stream reset by CombatState reset/iteration reset (track I owns)
note: Track I owns the canonical RNG record; this is the E-local view.
